Title: Write knowledge rows and saga from collector server
Description: As a backend engineer, I want a collector server inside desktop/collector that writes desktop knowledge into Cortexa's Cosmos and publishes ingestion.completed, so the existing, unchanged pipeline (extraction, evidence, scoring, harvesting/seeding) finds candidates from it. This story also scaffolds the collector solution shared by the server and the WPF app.
AcceptanceCriteria: Solution Collector.sln in desktop/collector with src/Collector.Domain (shared), server/Collector.Server.Api, server/Collector.Server.Application, server/Collector.Server.Infrastructure and tests/Collector.Server.Tests; Directory.Build.props (net10.0, nullable, warnings as errors) and Directory.Packages.props; dotnet build -warnaserror and dotnet test pass
Collector.Domain holds the knowledge item, upload contract and enums (KnowledgeKind, UnitKind, SourceKind, SourceType, CollectorProvider) shared by server and desktop

Writes rows in order: documents (status completed, blob_uri empty) -> chunks (one per knowledge item, id {document_id}|{order_index}, contiguous order_index, running start_char/end_char, token_count, page_number, section_hint, knowledge object with provider/model/prompt_version) -> provenance_maps (one per chunk) -> batches saga (InProgress, every doc Queued, active/queued lists empty, every list [] never null)
Cosmos rows use a System.Text.Json serializer re-implemented from the orchestrator so field names and enum strings match exactly (InProgress, Queued)

Publishes one ingestion.completed per document with chunk_count equal to its chunk rows: RabbitMQ locally (session_id and batch_id headers, persistent) and a Service Bus option (SessionId = batch_id); topic names from config
ingestion.requested and batch.created are never published for collector batches
Runs locally via desktop/collector/server/run-server.ps1 on localhost:5091 with its own git-ignored .env.collector-server (Cosmos emulator, RabbitMQ, identity); run-local.ps1 is not changed
Contract test inside desktop/collector pins the copied saga, chunk, document and event shapes
All code for this story lives inside Cortexa-dev/desktop/collector; nothing in services/, contracts/, frontend/ or deploy/ is edited or referenced (outside logic is re-implemented inside)
TalkingPoints: The collector server writes Cortexa-compatible rows and events from inside desktop/collector, so the existing pipeline runs unchanged. Known limits: web Retry on a collector doc stalls until the watchdog fails the batch; the web document viewer returns 404 (no blob).
